description: Audit-scoped geoip enrichment of Cloud audit forwarded client IPs. Guarded to the serverless.audit.otel dataset. NOTE: keys inside `attributes` are literal dotted strings (e.g. attributes['network.forwarded_ip']), so the IP must be lifted with a script processor rather than a dotted `field` path, which ingest would resolve as object traversal.

script.description: Lift the literal dotted key attributes['network.forwarded_ip'] to top-level client.ip
script.source: def a = ctx.attributes; if (a == null) { return; } def ip = a.get('network.forwarded_ip'); if (ip == null || ip == '') { return; } if (ctx.client == null) { ctx.client = new HashMap(); } ctx.client.ip = ip;
